<thought>Having validated the SMILES and confirmed that it accounts for the observed ¹H NMR (two aromatic doublets of 2 H each, a singlet for the methoxy group, and two equivalent ethylene‑type triplets), the ¹³C NMR (carbonyl ~166 ppm, aromatic carbons ~129–132 ppm, O‑CH₃ ~52 ppm, and the two aliphatic CH₂ at ~38 and ~44 ppm), and the molecular ion at m/z ≈ 179 (consistent with C₁₀H₁₂O₃), the most plausible structure is methyl 4‑hydroxy‑3‑phenylpropionate. Its SMILES representation is: COC(=O)CCc1ccc(O)cc1. This satisfies all spectral data and the molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>COC(=O)CCc1ccc(O)cc1</final_answer>
